title: PyModeler build script
description: An ordered list of modeling steps that builds a 3D model (Z up, millimetres by default).

anyOf.description: axis name: x, +x, -x, y, +y, -y, z, +z, -z, up, down

target.description: id of an earlier step, 'id[n]' for one part, a list of ids, or '*'

var.description: name of the index variable (default i)

values.description: iterate over these values instead of a count

as.description: name of the value variable (default value)

op_line.description: Draw connected straight edges. A closed, flat loop becomes a face.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

points.description: two or more points to connect in order

closed.description: also connect the last point back to the first

op_rectangle.description: Draw a rectangular face from a corner (or its centre).

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

origin.description: corner of the rectangle (its centre if center is true)

width.description: size along the plane's first axis (X for xy and xz, Y for yz)

depth.description: size along the plane's second axis (Y for xy, Z for xz and yz)

height.description: size along the plane's second axis (Y for xy, Z for xz and yz)

plane.description: drawing plane: xy (ground, faces +Z), xz (faces front, -Y), yz (faces right, +X)

normal.description: front direction of the shape; overrides 'plane'

x_axis.description: direction of the shape's local X axis within its plane

op_circle.description: Draw a circular face (a polygon with many sides, marked as one curve).

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

segments.description: number of straight segments approximating the curve

plane.description: drawing plane: xy (ground, faces +Z), xz (faces front, -Y), yz (faces right, +X)

normal.description: front direction of the shape; overrides 'plane'

op_arc.description: Draw an arc of a circle; optionally close it into a face.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

start_angle.description: start angle, counter-clockwise from the plane's first axis

close.description: none (open curve), chord (straight closing edge) or pie (through the centre)

plane.description: drawing plane: xy (ground, faces +Z), xz (faces front, -Y), yz (faces right, +X)

normal.description: front direction of the shape; overrides 'plane'

x_axis.description: direction of the shape's local X axis within its plane

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

radius.description: distance from centre to the corners (or edge midpoints)

inscribed.description: corners on the radius (true) or edge midpoints on it (false)

plane.description: drawing plane: xy (ground, faces +Z), xz (faces front, -Y), yz (faces right, +X)

normal.description: front direction of the shape; overrides 'plane'

op_face.description: Draw a face from an outline of points (any flat polygon, optionally with holes).

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

holes.description: outlines of holes inside the face

normal.description: front direction of the shape; overrides 'plane'

op_guide.description: Add a construction guide: a dashed line through a point, or a guide point.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

point.description: a point the guide passes through (or the guide point)

direction.description: direction of a guide line; leave out for a guide point

op_push_pull.description: Extrude a face along its normal (SketchUp's Push/Pull).

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

face.description: which face(s) of the target; may be omitted when the target is a single face

distance.description: how far to push (negative pushes into the solid)

create_new.description: keep the original face in place (like holding Ctrl)

op_follow_me.description: Sweep a profile face along a path (SketchUp's Follow Me).

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

face.description: which face(s) of the target; may be omitted when the target is a single face

path.description: points of the path, or the id of earlier lines/arcs

closed.description: treat the path as a closed loop (default: closed if it ends where it starts)

op_offset.description: Draw a copy of a face's outline inside (positive) or outside (negative) it.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

face.description: which face(s) of the target; may be omitted when the target is a single face

op_extrude.description: Make a prism: a face from an outline, pushed along a direction.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

height.description: distance along the profile's normal (right-hand rule on the points)

group.description: wrap the solid in its own group so it never sticks to other geometry

name.description: name shown in the outliner (also usable as a reference)

op_opening.description: Cut a rectangular opening (door, window) into a face of a solid or group.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

face.description: the face to cut into, e.g. "front"

origin.description: lower-left corner of the opening, on (or near) the face

depth.description: how deep to cut, or "through" to cut through the wall

op_move.description: Move the target by a vector, or from one point to another.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

face.description: move only these faces (connected geometry stretches)

from.description: reference point (default: the target's bounding-box minimum)

op_rotate.description: Rotate the target about an axis.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

angle.description: degrees, counter-clockwise looking down the axis

op_scale.description: Scale the target uniformly or per axis.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

face.description: scale only these faces (e.g. the top of a box to taper it)

op_mirror.description: Mirror the target across a plane (optionally keeping the original).

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

axis.description: normal of the mirror plane ("x" flips left/right)

center.description: a point on the mirror plane

copy.description: keep the original and add a mirrored copy

op_copy.description: Copy the target, displaced by a vector.

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

to.description: where the 'from' point of the copy goes

from.description: reference point (default: the target's bounding-box minimum)

op_array.description: Make several copies in a row (offset) or around an axis (angle).

id.description: name for what this step creates

tag.description: put what this step creates on a tag

in.description: run inside this group or component

count.description: number of copies to add (the original stays)
